name: CJC-1295 (No DAC) + Ipamorelin Blend
storage: Store at -20 °C, protected from light and moisture.
definition: CJC-1295 (No DAC) + Ipamorelin Blend (CP) is a multi-component peptide blend supplied as white lyophilized powder. The catalogue lists 2 pack sizes: 10 mg, 20 mg. The CAS number, full sequence and molecular weight are recorded in the lot-specific certificate of analysis (COA). Each unit combines CJC-1295 (No DAC) and Ipamorelin in equal parts. Purity is stated at ≥99.0% (HPLC) with white lyophilized powder appearance. For laboratory research use only; not for human or veterinary use.

faq.question: How is CJC-1295 (No DAC) + Ipamorelin Blend tested for purity and identity?
faq.answer: Each CP lot is run on RP-HPLC against a ≥99.0% (HPLC) release limit, then confirmed by MS. The batch certificate carries the measured purity, retention time and mass together with the identity string (CAS 863288-34-0 + 170851-70-4, formula C152H252N44O42 + C38H49N9O5, 3367.90 Da + 711.9 Da Da).

faq.question: How should CJC-1295 (No DAC) + Ipamorelin Blend be stored?
faq.answer: CJC-1295 (No DAC) + Ipamorelin Blend ships lyophilized and should stay at −20 °C until reconstitution; after that keep it at 2–8 °C and avoid freeze–thaw cycles.

faq.question: What pack sizes are available for CJC-1295 (No DAC) + Ipamorelin Blend?
faq.answer: CJC-1295 (No DAC) + Ipamorelin Blend is stocked in 2 pack sizes (10 mg, 20 mg), 10 vials per kit, MOQ 1 kit. At 1–9 kits the per-kit price is $91.92; 10–49 kits falls to $84.56 (−8%) and 50+ to $78.14 (−15%).
